---
title: Dashboard configuration
description: Every environment variable the dashboard reads, with its default.
---

<!-- Generated by apps/dashboard/scripts/docgen.ts from src/server/settings.ts. Don't edit by hand. -->

The dashboard reads these environment variables at start. The engine's settings are in [Configuration](/docs/reference/configuration/).

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `LUMBUNG_DASHBOARD_URL` | `http://localhost:4871` | The address people open, without `/app`. Sign-in cookies, passkeys and the origin check bind to it, so set it to the public address behind a proxy. |
| `LUMBUNG_ENGINE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:4870` | Where the dashboard reaches the engine's REST API. Under Docker Compose, `http://engine:4870`. |
| `LUMBUNG_PUBLIC_ENGINE_URL` | none | The engine address shown in connect snippets. When unset, the dashboard's own address, which fits a proxy that serves both under one name. |
| `LUMBUNG_SERVICE_TOKEN` | none | The engine's service token. When unset, it's read from `LUMBUNG_SERVICE_TOKEN_FILE`. |
| `LUMBUNG_SERVICE_TOKEN_FILE` | `../engine/data/secrets/service-token` | A file holding the service token, like the `secrets/service-token` the engine writes in its data folder. Read on first use. |
| `LUMBUNG_DASHBOARD_DATA_DIR` | `./data` | Folder for `dashboard.db` (users, sessions, passkeys and invites) and the generated session secret. |
| `LUMBUNG_AUTH_SECRET` | none | Signs sessions, at least 32 characters. When unset, one is generated on first start and kept in `secrets/auth-secret` in the data folder, mode 600. |
| `LUMBUNG_CLIENT_IP_HEADER` | none | The header that carries the client address behind a proxy, like `X-Forwarded-For` or `CF-Connecting-IP`. When unset, the connection's address is used. Same as the engine's setting. |
| `LUMBUNG_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `127.0.0.1/32,::1/128` | Comma-separated IPs or CIDR networks allowed to set the client address header. An `X-Forwarded-For` list is read from the right, skipping these. Same as the engine's setting. |
